State: the design pedestrian load; the design wind action; the first vertical natural frequency and the outcome of the vibration comfort check; and the governing ultimate limit state combination and whether it is satisfied. Return a JSON object. Inputs from the analysis model: design pedestrian load 5.0 kN/m² (national annex); design wind action on the truss 1.8 kN per metre of span (peak velocity pressure 0.94 kN/m²); first vertical natural frequency 2.1 Hz; peak vertical acceleration under the design crowd 0.52 m/s², at an assumed damping ratio of 0.5 %; bottom-chord utilisation at the ultimate limit state 0.86 under the pedestrian-leading combination and 0.91 under the wind-leading combination. Comfort criteria: a first vertical frequency between 1.25 and 2.3 Hz requires a dynamic response check, and the comfort limit is 0.7 m/s².
